sources: Yahoo Finance ^GSPC daily closes 1950 to Nov 19 2026: 446 days with a close-to-close drop of 2% or more (2.3% of trading days); 1 month (21 trading days) later higher 65% (290/444), 1 year (252 trading days) later higher 75% (333/442), median 1-year change +17.2%; yearly counts 2017-2026: 0,15,5,25,5,23,1,4,7,4
Worst days cross-checked with Wikipedia 'List of largest daily changes in the S&P 500' and the Yahoo series: Oct 19 1987 -20.47%, Oct 28 1929 -12.94%, Mar 16 2020 -11.98%, Oct 15 2008 -9.03%
S&P 500 closes Nov 18 2026 7,323.63 (AP/La Nacion 'How major US stock indexes fared' + Yahoo); Nov 19 2026 7,175.83 (Yahoo, -2.0%)
